title: Big Island in a Day: Volcanoes Waterfalls Sightseeing and History
overview: The Big Island of Hawaii has a diverse ecosystem unlike anywhere else on the planet, and on this day-long nature tour, experience the beauty of its black-sand beaches, thundering waterfalls, and Hawaii Volcanoes National Park. If you’re lucky, find Hawaiian green sea turtles basking on the coast.
inclusions: Small Group Tour Lead by a Professional Guide
Kona/ Kohala Coast area hotel pickup and drop-off

title: Hilo Shore Excursion: Volcanoes National Park and Rainbow Falls
overview: Sample a cross-section of outdoor sights on the Big Island during this shore excursion exploring Volcanoes National Park, waterfall, black sand beach and more. Discover the postcard-perfect Rainbow Falls before visiting the amazing volcanic steam vents and unique geology around Kilauea Volcano. Before your day is done, check out a local macadamia nut farm and visit a gorgeous black sand beach. A guide, park entrance fees, and round-trip port transport are included.
itineraryStops: Mauna Loa Macadamia Nut Visitor Center
inclusions: Port / Hilo Hotel pickup and drop-off
What to bring/wear: Walking shoes, light sweater, camera, hat, sunglasses
Stop is made to purchase food

title: Hawaii’s GOAT Experience: Mauna Kea Summit, Sunset & Stars
overview: Enjoy a sunset and stargazing experience like no other on this small-group trip to Mauna Kea—the highest point in the Hawaiian islands. Following afternoon pickup, travel in a 4x4 van to the summit—you can change into a warm jacket and pair of gloves, and sip a hot beverage, as the sun starts to set. Then, learn why so many research telescopes are located here during a brilliant celestial show.
inclusions: Jackets and gloves to keep you warm
FREE night photo with our professional camera

title: Small Group Big Island Twilight Volcano and Stargazing Tour
overview: Pack in some of Hawaii’s most mesmerizing sights during this Big Island full-day and twilight volcano tour. Sample Kona-grown coffee from a local coffee farm, taste Hawaiian sweet bread at Punalu’u Bakery, and look for sea turtles at Punalu'u Black Sand Beach. Then, explore Volcanoes National Park before ending your experience by stargazing in a secluded location—perfect for taking in views of the night sky.
inclusions: Use of Rain and Warm Jacket
Kona/ Kohala Coast area hotel pickup and drop-off
Small-group tour lead by a professional guide

title: Mauna Kea Summit Tour with Free Night Star Photo
overview: The 13,803-foot (4,207.3-meter) peak of Mauna Kea is Hawaii's highest point, and a popular spot for star-gazing. With this tour, travel up to the summit with your guide, stop for dinner at the Onizuka Astronomy Complex, then arrive at the summit in time to watch the sunset. As dark sets in, enjoy a guided stargazing experience and marvel at the stars and planets using a refractor telescope and razor pointer.
inclusions: BLT or Vegan sandwich (Please let us know by day before the tour or it will be automatically a BLT)
Snow parker, Ski pants, and Gloves
Free DSLR camera photo of stars with you in it! (weather and moon phase permitting))
An optional TIP per person for good service is customary in Hawaii.
Guest under 16 years old or older than 75 cannot participate
Please arrive at the meeting location 5min prior to pick up time

title: Big Island Highlights: Coffee, Volcano, Black Sands & Waterfall
overview: Spend a full day exploring the Big Island with visits to waterfalls, beaches, tropical valleys, stunning viewpoints, and so much more. Learn about Kona’s coffee culture with a visit to Greenwell Coffee Farm, for an insider's perspective and to sample the locally cultivated coffee. See Hawaii’s natural beauty at Punalu’u Black Sands Beach, where you can look out for Hawaiian green sea turtles, make multiple stops in Volcanoes National Park, and soak up the beauty of Rainbow Falls all in a day.
inclusions: East Hawaii pickups in Hilo or Volcano

title: Deluxe Volcano Experience with Restaurant Dinner
overview: Witness the raw power of one of the world's largest and most dynamic volcanoes on this full-day, small-group excursion. Discover the island's coffee region and enjoy lunch at Greenwell Farms. Look out for sea turtles at Punalu's Black Sand Beach before taking in the scenery at Volcanoes National Park. End with a 3-course dinner at an acclaimed Volcano restaurant.

title: Volcanoes National Park Safari
overview: Fly away from Hilo Airport and into a world of volcanoes, rainbows, and waterfalls. With this family-run helicopter company—the longest-running on the island—you’ll meet your captain, get debriefed on safety protocol, and hop into your helicopter for a wild aerial adventure. With your captain doubling as guide, you’ll explore the volcanoes of the national park, lava flows, orchid farms, lush forests, and so much more.

title: Small-Group Big Island Tour: Hawaii Volcanoes National Park and Kona Coffee Farm
overview: On this tour from Kona to Hawaii Volcanoes National Park, experience some of the Big Island’s best sights in a small group capped at 14 people. In addition to stopping at Punalu’u Beach Park to walk down a black-sand beach, you have the chance to sip Kona coffee on the plantation right where it’s grown, as well as hike through a lava tube that was formed by Kilauea volcano.
inclusions: Hawaii Volcanoes National Park Fees included
Black sand beach with potential to see the green sea turtles
Hotel pickup and drop-off from Kailua-Kona, Waikoloa, Kohala Coast (personal pick-up time varies)

title: Volcano National Park Adventure From Kona
overview: Many tours can take you to Volcanoes National Park, but only this one lets you spend your day with a geologist who can provide information that others can't. This small-group geology-based tour offers a far richer experience of the world's most active volcano, Kilauea, than you'd get anywhere else. You also visit a coffee farm, Rainbow Falls, and Punaluu Black Sand Beach.
inclusions: Water, drinks. Coats, raincoats, and umbrellas

title: Acatenango Volcano Tour with Overnight from Antigua
overview: Summit the Acatenango Volcano and reach nearly 13,000 feet (4,000 meters) above sea level on this 2-day trekking tour. You'll camp overnight to increase your chances of watching the adjacent El Fuego volcano erupt and admire sweeping views of Guatemala from high above the clouds. Your bi-lingual guide is with you every step of the way to ensure the best experience possible.
inclusions: Transport by private vehicle to and from our office in Antigua
Free rental gear (backpacks, headtorches and warm clothes)
Pre-Trip meeting at 5pm the day before the tour

title: Big Island Volcano Deluxe Helicopter Tour
overview: See the steam vents and fiery lava streams of Kilauea during a Big Island aerial tour by six-passenger helicopter. View Mauna Kea and Mauna Loa while soaring over Hawaii Volcanoes National Park; hover above waterfalls cascading from the cliffs of Kohala; and marvel at the rain forest of the Hamakua coast. You’ll get a comprehensive look at Hawaii in a short time.
inclusions: All taxes, fees and handling charges
HD video of actual flight on USB (available to purchase)

title: Big Island Volcano Adventure from Kona: Small Group
overview: The Big Island is one of the most diverse places on earth. For visitors, it can be difficult to comprehend the vastness of the island's diversity but this tour offers the chance to immerse yourself in it. You'll explore the rainforests and waterfalls along Mauna Kea's Hamakua Coast and the summit of the active volcano Kilauea in Hawaii Volcanoes National Park, before watching Kilauea's lava lake glowing after sunset.

title: Hilo: Helicopter Lava and Rainforests Adventure
overview: A must-do for adrenaline junkies, this aerial adventure takes you over the island’s volcanic landscape, so you can peer into craters and spot lava. Plus enjoy views of waterfalls and other natural features of the Big Island while aboard.
inclusions: Two-way headset communication with your pilot

title: Volcano National Park Adventure from Waikoloa
overview: Hawaii Volcanoes National Park features actually unique landscapes—like the world's most active volcano, Kilauea. Join a small group and deepen your experience of the park's unique geological, biological, and cultural landscapes as you tour the entire Chain of Craters Road from summit to sea. You also make stops at Rainbow Falls, Punalu'u Black-Sand Beach, and a coffee farm for a taste of local culture.
itineraryStops: Heavenly Hawaiian Kona Coffee Farm Tours & Konalani Coffee Bar

title: Hawaii Volcanoes National Park Experience Departing from Oahu
overview: Get away from the Oahu buzz with this whirlwind volcano-chasing tour. After your short flight from Honolulu, arrive in Kona to meet your driver for a serious adventure: You’ll visit the historic town of Kona, set your eyes on the Mars-like Kilauea Iki Overlook, run your toes along black sand, and explore Hawaii Volcanoes National Park, an active volcanic landscape that’s creating the Big Island to this day.
inclusions: Roundtrip airfare to Kona International Airport from Honolulu International Airport is included

title: Hilo: Doors-Off Helicopter Lava and Rainforests Adventure
overview: Get views of the Big Island's volcanoes and waterfalls from the air on this helicopter flight from Hilo. Fly over the rain forest, lava flows, craters, and the Wailuku River. Upgrade to guarantee a window seat for the best views. Multiple departure times are available to suit your schedule.

title: Private Guide Meet In Hawaii Volcanoes National Park
overview: Discover the awe-inspiring landscapes of the Hawaii Volcanoes National Park with a private certified guide. Meet your guide at the park and set out on a thrilling tour of the park's lava flows, viewpoints, and eruption sites. Travel in the comfort of a luxury Mercedes van and enjoy an itinerary customized for your group, whether you want to hike through lava fields or just soak up the scenery.

title: Volcano Boarding Private Tour
overview: An active volcano. A modified snowboard. A thrill ride only Nicaragua can deliver. This unique activity is a once in a lifetime opportunity to board down an active volcano. Cerro Negro is 728 meters high and quite active. You’ll join this private guided tour in Leon, climb to the top of the volcano, then board down its rocky, black slope for an experience like no other.
inclusions: Carry Less - Enjoy More (Boards hauling is included)

title: Big Island: Discover Hilo Helicopter Tour
overview: The best way to see Hawaii’s steaming vents and glowing lava has always been like the birds. You’ll get that feeling on this helicopter tour, soaring above one of the most volcanically active islands on the planet. Getting the pilot’s commentary via headphones, you’ll witness waterfalls, craters, the craggy coastline, and—if you're lucky—the volcano’s fiery glow.

title: Big Island Spectacular Helicopter Tour
overview: Fly above Hawaii's spectacular peaks, coasts, and valleys on this helicopter tour of the Big Island. Watch lava bubble up out of volcanoes, fly over the lush rain forests of the Hamakua Coast, and complete your trip with views of the waterfalls lining the Kohala Mountains. Only a helicopter tour lets you see so many of Hawaii's charms on a single ride and from an unforgettable perspective.

title: Private Big Island Experience: 3 of 4 Window Seats
overview: This comprehensive helicopter tour of the Big Island treats you like a VIP. Take your Hawaii adventure to the skies, departing from Kona International Airport. You’ll head straight to Kilauea via the saddle running between Mauna Kea and Mauna Loa, Hawaii’s tallest mountains.
